detail.longDescription: We launched AI investigations in Radar today. Click Investigate on a broken workload and your own agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or OpenCode) finds the root cause, read-only, with the evidence for each claim. Radar is open source under Apache 2.0. Launch page: https://www. producthunt.com/products/radar -7?launch=radar-101 # Kubernetes # DevOps # SRE # OpenSource # MCP
